```
services/auth/tests/test_token.py::test_token_expiry FAILED
E   assert 160 < 120
E   AssertionError: token expiry longer than expected
```
dora: that assert looks legit — could be clock skew on CI VMs or a real regression from the change that touched utils/time.
alice: my patch didn't touch utils/time. I'm going to rerun tests once after we merge the hotfix; if it still fails we quarantine the test.
emily: decision: merge hotfix (only lint changes) then re-run full pipeline on the hotfix commit. if tests still fail, mark test_token_expiry flaky and unblock staging.
